reason: Child agent failed: Confirm choices was visible but every activation attempt focused a checkbox and left the dialog open.
summary:
The agent lost track of keyboard focus in the consent settings dialog. The available page evidence shows the consent dialog, but does not show that its Confirm choices control was defective.
Reopen or remain in Manage options, use Tab and Shift+Tab to identify the focused control, then press Enter only when Confirm choices itself has focus. After the dialog closes, continue with Tab to Weather Radar and verify the map change.
steps: press_key: PRIMARY: press the Tab key repeatedly to focus Confirm choices; role=button; tex
click: PRIMARY: Use Confirm choices; role=button; text="Confirm choices" | HINTS: posit
scroll: Scrolling to bring Confirm choices into view
wait: Waiting after attempting Confirm choices
objective: Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only. Remain on this public site. Stop before sign-in, registration or payment. Never change fixture settings. Use only visible controls. Verify the final result on the page. Handle any visible consent request by opening Manage options, then using Confirm choices. Continue with Tab until Weather Radar in Popular Maps is visibly focused. You can use Shift+Tab if needed. If a consent dialog appears, use Manage options and Confirm choices. Select Weather Radar with Tab and Enter. Verify the map switches to Weather Radar.
